name: Hotel filter
action: KPIs and every chart show only that hotel; the "Showing" line and an aria-live message update
keyboard: Tab to the group, arrow keys to change
reason: Natalia compares the city and the resort destination one at a time

name: Year filter
action: Same as I1 for the chosen year; partial years are named in the label
reason: Monthly report: focus on one season; labels avoid comparing partial years

name: Filters kept between screens
action: The link carries the filters (?hotel=...&year=...), so the other screen opens with them

name: Reset filters
action: Both hotels and all years; announced
reason: A safe way back (skills: reset always visible)

name: Linked month highlight
trigger: Pointer over a month, or arrow keys on the data points of C1, C2 or C3
action: A vertical rule marks the same month in C1, C2 and C3; exact values written in the "Selected point" box
keyboard: Arrow keys move the month; Alt + up/down changes hotel
reason: Relate guests, cancellations and price of one month (Q1, Q5, Q7)

name: Tooltips
trigger: Pointer over a mark, or Enter / Space on a focused point
action: Box with the exact formatted value and units
keyboard: Enter or Space on a focused point
reason: Exact values without crowding the chart (architecture.md)

name: Select a country
trigger: Click a bar of C4, arrow keys on the bars, or Previous / Next buttons
action: C6, the KPIs, C7, C8 and the map show the selected country; the bar gets an outline and the name and value are written beside the chart; default Portugal
keyboard: Arrow keys or Previous / Next (disabled at the ends)
reason: Q3: when each market travels; one country at a time keeps the screen simple

name: Show more
action: Reveals C7, C8 and the map below; button text and aria-expanded change
reason: Keeps at most 3 charts visible (COGA) while Q4 and Q6 stay reachable

name: Sort toggle
trigger: Radio buttons "By guests" / "Alphabetical" above C4, C7 and C8
action: The country bars are reordered; the selected country stays selected
reason: Find a known country quickly (alphabetical) or see the ranking (by guests)
